viewerPromise.targetViewer: pet-short viewers who like real anecdote energy, expressive dogs, and clean ironic payoff
viewerPromise.whyClickNow: The click reason is visible in both the trigger and the payoff: Jjiroo spots ducks, overcommits into the river, and the mother ends up looking more stranded than the dog.
viewerPromise.promise: Watch Jjiroo turn a calm riverside walk into a duck chase, then climb out on his own and give the soaked mother a puzzled look.
viewerPromise.angle: owner-observed comic anecdote, not animal-danger spectacle
